test_names.name: suppresses solve proof unless the completed job, result, and exact model version remain bound
suppresses a real delayed backend completion when native open commits a new model
persists native immediate-cancel intent until the backend start receipt exists
dispatches detached pre-start cancellation once after native open invalidates the run
withdraws an in-flight apply without resurrecting state or clearing newer busy ownership
withdraws an in-flight validate without resurrecting state or clearing newer busy ownership
retains a malformed restored member as untrusted data and rejects it without crashing or accepting
discards a pending batch when another model opens, and ignores delayed save metadata after a model replacement
rejects missing proof, same-id changed model, stale run, changed value and mixed/null/empty/wrong dimensions
rejects a rehashed 0.2 known explicit carrier dimension contradiction without mutating evidence
keeps native primary error and cleanup status without echoing payload
rejects missing, forged and contradictory success receipts
does not publish a delayed packet after its source result is replaced
saves native stress JSON only after validation and intent and invalidates a pending source generation
does not misclassify a full Python 0.1 record as the abbreviated desktop profile
keeps locale-sensitive desktop 0.1 replay explicitly unverifiable
